node.statement: Apply lem-hcb-column-hilbert-squared to the H-CB datum, first with the projection T=P and then with T=R: for each compatible amplified column U, |q_T(U)^2-||U||_{n,1}^2|<=C_col*e*||U||_{n,1}^2, because q_T(U)^2=<U,U>_n by the registered column inner-product display.
